title: Carting in Makhuntseti
description: Carting in Makhuntseti is a fun and adrenaline-filled ride surrounded by beautiful mountain scenery. Enjoy fast laps and fresh air near one of Adjara’s most popular natural spots.

title: Mtirala Buggy Maverick Tour
description: Mtirala Buggy Maverick Tour is a thrilling off-road adventure through the lush forests and mountain trails of Mtirala National Park. Drive a powerful Maverick buggy and enjoy nature, adrenaline, and unforgettable views.

title: Buran in Goderdzi Mountain Pass
description: Buran is a snowmobile ride at Goderdzi Ski Resort, letting visitors explore the snowy mountains beyond the slopes. Fun, fast, and scenic — a great adventure for winter visitors.

title: Jeep Tour
description: A Jeep tour is an off-road adventure in a 4×4 vehicle, usually through mountainous or rugged terrain. It offers scenic views, thrilling rides, and access to remote areas that regular cars can’t reach. Perfect for adventure seekers and nature lovers.
